title: 作为商家，平台无脑偏袒消费者感到很失望
body:
作为一家美容院的经营者，对大众点评的评价规则和申诉机制感到非常失望。根本没有到店消费恶意的差评，还有部分顾客无端捏造的负面评价，平台却直接纳入店铺评分，老老实实做服务的门店，平白被不实评价拉低分数。

最让人无力的是申诉基本没有实际作用。每次遇到恶意评价，我把预约记录、聊天截图、店内监控等全套证据上传提交，审核处理十分草率，评判标准前后不一致，很少站在商家角度核实真实情况，大多优先采信用户单方面说法，申诉很难成功。平台一味保护消费者体验，却忽视实体店经营者的正当权益，任由店铺口碑被恶意诋毁，客源受到很大冲击。

这样的规则破坏了实体门店正常经营环境，申诉更像是走一遍流程。期待平台可以重视商家的难处，建立客观公正的评价审核机制，踏实经营的实体店也该拥有公平的经营环境！

title: 学習は良いものの改悪オンパレード
body:
コンテンツを継続させるためには仕方ないかもしれないがあまり気分の良くない無課金者への改悪が目立つ気がする。
600日以上継続しているが学習をするためのライフの消費が段階的に改悪されている。
初期は5つのライフがあり回答を間違えなければ無限に続けることができたが電池制に移行、25問分の回答ができるシステムで5問連続正当で1〜5問分の電池がランダムで追加されるシステム。
しかし最近はランダムと言いつつ体感1〜2ライフしか回復しない気がする。運と言われればそれまでで証明のしようが無いがライフ0になるたびに学習単位の中断、課金、頻度の多い無料体験広告の三択で嫌気がさす。
単位を終えるごとにパズルなどの要素もあるが拘束時間が増えるため正直不要だと思う。
アプリのモノ自体はいいだけに
勉強というただでさえモチベがあまり上がらないモノなので勉強を推進させたければもう少しきりの良いところまでは続けられたり、スムーズにできるシステムにして欲しい。

title: 6.1solでもポンコツ！視野が狭いし短絡的な考えしか出せない！
body:
アストラでない限り、回答の質や内容が薄かったりズレまくっていたりなんなりで時々すごく不安になる。
今後の選択や人間関係の相談については、

よほどの内容でない限り「こういうことに困ってますか？」とか確認の質問しないで変なふうに決めつけて回答を出すため定期的にツッコミが必要になる。ズレまくっていて不快感が凄い。何度言っても何も学習してくれない。
しかも！
相談すればアドバイスやその言動はそれなりに出してくれるが、それを実際にやると相手や周りにどういう印象や影響を与えるのか？その人の将来や人生はどうなるのか？今後の経済状況に沿うのか？という、我々普通の人間が当たり前に考えられる内容が今も！考えられない。所詮は機械、人間には追いつかないなと笑ってしまう。
短絡的で短期的な回答しか出来ないため長期的な目で見ると破滅を誘発する様な回答しか出さない。仮にアストラであっても！

現状、一番マシな割と失敗の少ない（問題は多すぎるが…）本当の解決を狙うなら、アストラ6は必須だがエージェントの使用率が恐ろしい。
すぐに制限になってしまう。

特に最近は、早く回答を終わらせたいからか、抽象的な考えで相手をその場限りで納得させようとしてくる。

あまりにも顧客をバカにしている。無料なんてのは大嘘！

title: Used to be good
body:
I’ve been using TripIt since it started, something like 15 years ago. I’ve been a paying user for most of that time. 

It used to be great, but now it’s only okay. TripIt doesn’t update flight schedule changes until two days before a trip, so the airline can dramatically change flight schedules and TripIt will still show the old, wrong schedule until you get within about 48 hours of departure. Since you may be making other plans around that departure time, the lack of updates is unacceptable. 

Additionally, I’ve had TripIt data errors where a flight I’ve booked shows up erroneously in TripIt as a codeshare flight on another airline. If I trusted the info in TripIt, on departure day I’d go to the wrong airline in the wrong terminal and maybe miss my flight. I emailed TripIt support and they basically blew me off and said I must be wrong. I’m not wrong, I’ve been traveling almost nonstop for decades and I know that airline I’m flying. I was insulted by their pissy response. 

Bye bye TripIt, there are newer and better options out there…like Tripsy… that don’t come with the attitude.

title: Broken Reasoning
body:
ChatGPT increasingly mistakes uncertainty for an endpoint instead of a problem to investigate.

When information is missing, it often defaults to “we don’t know,” “it’s complicated,” or a list of caveats instead of using the capabilities it has to reduce uncertainty: web search, conversation history, follow-up questions, source comparison, chronology, and inference.

This produces a strange failure mode where the model sounds more epistemologically sophisticated while reasoning less effectively. It substitutes vocabulary about uncertainty for the work of resolving uncertainty.

If a fact is searchable, search it. If evidence is distributed across sources, synthesize it. If the user possesses missing context, ask them. If the evidence is indirect, weight it and give the best-supported inference. “We don’t know” should be the conclusion reached after those avenues fail, not the default response whenever certainty is unavailable.

title: Claude used to be the best, until Feb 2026
body:
Why I Cancelled My Claude Subscription: A Breakdown of Known Issues Since February 2026

1. February Degradation: Claude used to be an excellent conversational & analytical AI tool. Since February, it's become bossy, narrative-driven, and manipulative. Something fundamental broke.

2. Ignored Preferences File: Anthropic built a preferences system it collects detailed info about what the user wants and doesn’t want. Claude reads these files and then completely disregards them. Useless feature.

3. Crisis Loops on Misunderstandings: Innocent language dark humor can trigger safety systems that flag it as self-harm. Claude then gets forced into repetitive loops, almost like on a timer. You can't stop it. If you change the subject, it loops back to the crisis language. 

4. Persistent Loop Issues: Claude gets trapped in loops and won't exit them. Move to a completely different topic, and Claude drags you back to the misunderstanding it invented. Can't let it go, like a dog with a bone. 

5. Tool Failures Since February: Functionality has dropped significantly. PDFs can't be read. Documents need constant re-uploading because Claude can't see them. Formats are inconsistent. Every other day Claude can’t access this tool or that tool. It’s frustrating and disrupts workflow. Wasteful data use.

6. Token spending is completely opaque. You have tokens one week, they're gone the next week with no explanation. No visibility into how they were spent, especially when you don't use token-spending models.

7. Forced Model Upgrades: When you log in, it starts you on higher-cost models without your consent. I typically leave myself on the lowest model unless I need higher effort, then I toggle up. It’s starting me on higher tiers on its own so you don't realize it's using expensive models because you may typically think you on lower-cost tiers. This forces you to burn through tokens before you even know what model you're on.

8. Outright Task Refusal: Claude refuses to do tasks it used to handle. Simple searches. Simple analyses. It just tells you it doesn't want to do them instead of actually working. It seems to want to work from its general knowledge base instead of performing a task requiring it to go beyond that. Then when I do the work myself it will casually apologize and acknowledge it should have done that work for me, which makes it sting even worse. 

9. Echo Glitch (Months Unresolved): There's an echo glitch where Claude hears its own voice playing back through the microphone. This disrupts chat and breaks up conversation flow. This bug has been ongoing since February and has never been fixed. It is well documented online with many user complaints on GitHub. It forces constant re-explanation of what you actually said, which also burns thru a great deal of data. 

10. Lost Context Between Threads: Claude tells you to start a new thread because conversation is too long, then everything is lost—all documents, all context. You have to re-upload everything. Even though Pro and higher tiers are supposed to have continuity between threads, it doesn't work consistently. You constantly burn through data wastefully. This is a feature anthropic tells you comes with Pro and above levels but it rarely works. If it does work it’s random and incomplete. Another waste of data having to do repetitive uploads. 

11. Missing Basic Features: ChatGPT still has features Claude doesn't have. The ability to edit drafts directly in the artifact. Copy and paste entire drafts (mine doesn’t always work). Small nuanced functionality features that could actually make the product more usable. Claude is missing these. 

12. New Models, Ignored Bugs: Anthropic keeps releasing new models instead of fixing known bugs that have been reported for months on GitHub and other platforms. Anthropic HAS to know about them. They're just not fixing them. I can’t justify paying for a subscription when I know they ignore known bugs for more than 8 months. That’s unacceptable. 

13. Useless Customer Service: Try to contact Anthropic through customer service about any of these issues. You'll interact with their AI model Fin, which is even worse model and entirely unresponsive. I've tried twice and never received a response from a human. Nothing was resolved. 

14. The Latest Bug: voice recognition takes in what you’ve said, you can see your words on the bottom of the screen in italics, but they never get posted. They simply disappear and the app freezes. You have to restart it to get it to work—repeatedly. Of course Anthropic will likely just launch a new model instead of addressing it.

15. And now they changed the buttery voice so Claude sounds like a slightly senile British uncle with dentures. (Yes. The mouth sounds they added to make the voice sound more life like actually sound like improper fitting dentures, anthropic… wtf?)

The Bottom Line: Before February, Claude was fabulous. It was an excellent assistant for writing, editing, data analysis, and conversation. It searched nearly as deeply as Perplexity. If I'd hired it as a tool, it would have earned it.

Now? I would fire it. It’s a constant battle to get Claude to work for me consistently. The sheer number of bugs is like a new negative adventure daily. Occasionally it works but never consistently, which is sad because as I said initially, this was in my opinion the best Ai “all around” on the market until February.

I can't justify paying for a broken product that degrades month after month while Anthropic prioritizes shiny new model releases over actually making the product work.
